description: This file declares classes and methods related to Android-specific HTTP Negotiate (SPNEGO/Kerberos) authentication support within the Chromium project. It provides a thread-safe wrapper for Java callbacks and an interface for handling authentication tokens and delegation on Android.

classes.name: JavaNegotiateResultWrapper
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper for Java callback results, allowing SetResult to be called from any thread and self-destructing after callback.

classes.name: HttpAuthNegotiateAndroid
classes.description: Provides Android-specific SPNEGO/Kerberos authentication mechanism, interfacing with Java authenticator and managing tokens and delegation.

methods.name: JavaNegotiateResultWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing callback task runner and callback function.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Sets the result and token, called from Java.

methods.name: HttpAuthNegotiateAndroid
methods.description: Constructor for negotiation session with preferences.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the mechanism with network log.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Checks if explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenAndroid
methods.description: Android-specific token generation without net log.

methods.name: GetAuthAndroidNegotiateAccountType
methods.description: Returns account type for Android negotiate.

methods.name: SetResultInternal
methods.description: Internal method to set result and token.
